name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Customer Success & Account Management — Retention, Onboarding, and Business Reviews
summary: Customer success and account management professional who retained all but one of a 15–20 partner portfolio at Birdeye (~94%, deals $10K–$45K) and onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at Wix while holding 110% of implementation targets. 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and service-based businesses owning the post-sale relationship end to end: onboarding and training, business reviews, adoption and KPI reporting, churn risk, and expansion. Works backward from each client's business objectives, and builds the processes and training that keep delivery consistent across a portfolio.

bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Own post-sale value delivery for B2B clients, architecting onboarding and technical setup that drives product adoption at scale.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.
Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, translating business requirements into technical configurations and providing hands-on training.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist

Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.

Guided customers through complex technical setup and configuration, and partnered with Product and Engineering to route structured, high-priority feedback into the roadmap.
